title: 缺失值体检：数量、比例、按行按列
expected_output:
=== 原始数据（None / NaN 都算缺失）===
 id city  amount note
  1   BJ   100.0  NaN
  2  NaN   200.0  NaN
  3   SH     NaN   ok
  4   GZ   400.0  NaN
  5  NaN     NaN    x
  6   SH   600.0  NaN

=== 1. 每列缺失数量与比例 ===
  column   count    pct
  id       0        0.0%
  city     2        33.3%
  amount   2        33.3%
  note     4        66.7%

=== 2. 每行缺失数量（决定能不能 dropna）===
  按行缺失数: [1, 2, 1, 1, 2, 1]
  完全无缺失的行数: 0
  有任意缺失的行数: 6

=== 3. 各列 dtype（注意 city/note 是 object，amount 是 float）===
  id       int64
  city     str
  amount   float64
  note     str

=== 4. 聚合默认跳过缺失（分母是非空个数）===
  sum()              = 1300.0
  count()            = 4 （非空个数，不是行数）
  mean()             = 325.0
  mean(skipna=False) = nan
  自己算 sum/len     = 216.66667  <- 这是「含缺失行」的口径

=== 5. 缺失太多时该考虑直接删列 ===
  note 缺失率 66.7% -> 建议删列或重新采集
code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6],
    "city": ["BJ", None, "SH", "GZ", None, "SH"],
    "amount": [100.0, 200.0, np.nan, 400.0, np.nan, 600.0],
    "note": [None, None, "ok", None, "x", None],
})
print("=== 原始数据（None / NaN 都算缺失）===")
print(df.to_string(index=False))

print()
print("=== 1. 每列缺失数量与比例 ===")
cnt = df.isna().sum()
pct = (df.isna().mean() * 100).round(1)
print("  %-8s %-8s %s" % ("column", "count", "pct"))
for col in df.columns:
    print("  %-8s %-8d %.1f%%" % (col, cnt[col], pct[col]))

print()
print("=== 2. 每行缺失数量（决定能不能 dropna）===")
print("  按行缺失数:", df.isna().sum(axis=1).tolist())
print("  完全无缺失的行数:", int((df.isna().sum(axis=1) == 0).sum()))
print("  有任意缺失的行数:", int((df.isna().sum(axis=1) > 0).sum()))

print()
print("=== 3. 各列 dtype（注意 city/note 是 object，amount 是 float）===")
for col, dt in df.dtypes.items():
    print("  %-8s %s" % (col, dt))

print()
print("=== 4. 聚合默认跳过缺失（分母是非空个数）===")
amt = df["amount"]
print("  sum()              =", amt.sum())
print("  count()            =", int(amt.count()), "（非空个数，不是行数）")
print("  mean()             =", round(amt.mean(), 2))
print("  mean(skipna=False) =", amt.mean(skipna=False))
print("  自己算 sum/len     =", round(amt.sum() / len(amt), 5), " <- 这是「含缺失行」的口径")

print()
print("=== 5. 缺失太多时该考虑直接删列 ===")
for col in df.columns:
    r = df[col].isna().mean()
    if r > 0.5:
        print("  %s 缺失率 %.1f%% -> 建议删列或重新采集" % (col, r * 100))
